## Journey highlights

The itinerary brings together several of Costa Rica’s distinctive natural regions. In Rincón de la Vieja, enjoy adventure activities and volcanic thermal springs. The Tenorio area is home to Río Celeste and tropical rainforest. In a Maleku village, the journey turns to culture and the traditions of this Indigenous community.

The following days are spent around Arenal. View the rainforest from the hanging bridges at Mistico Park, then explore the old lava fields along the Arenal 1968 trail. A scenic taxi–boat–taxi transfer takes you across Lake Arenal to Monteverde.

The final part of the journey is more relaxed: after the cloud forest, travel to Costa Rica’s northern Pacific coast for a free day by the sea.
